Question: assalam alaekum muhatram janab maulana sahab mera masla hai ki meri shop hai jis se ek madarsa saman kharidta hai aur jab ramzan je mahine mean jab zakat nikalte hai tab hum sirf rasid bana lete hai aur baad mean hame jo madarse se kuch amount lene huta hai usme se wo amout cut ker lete hai kiys is tarha se hamari zakat ada hu jaengi? aap ke jawab ke muntazir Answer ID: 8184 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1899/1079=B/1429) Your zakah will not be valid in this way. The scholars of Fiqh have written two ways for paying zakah . First, when you calculate your wealth, you should separate the amount of zakah with the intention of Zakah and then give it to the poor. Secondly, when you give it to the poor you should make the intention of Zakah. Therefore, you should receive your amount from the Madrasa and then pay it as Zakah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
